vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species felis_catus --assembly F.catus_Fca126_mat1.0 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the two sequences the records sit on (chromosome F1 and the unplaced scaffold JAFEKA010000047.1) at their full length from Felis_catus.F.catus_Fca126_mat1.0.dna.primary_assembly.F1.fa and Felis_catus.F.catus_Fca126_mat1.0.dna.nonchromosomal.fa of Ensembl release 116, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 220 records on chromosome F1 and the unplaced scaffold JAFEKA010000047.1. 166 are designed records that tools/vep-seeded-variants wrote from the converted cache and the genome sequence (--records wide, seed 1), their IDs the category and an ordinal: start and stop codons, missense and synonymous changes on each strand, splice donors and acceptors, both untranslated regions, introns, upstream, downstream and intergenic positions, frameshift insertions and deletions, in-frame deletions, the first and the last base of each sequence, and records that name their sequence by a synonym (CM031428.1 for F1, chrA2_random_Un_scaffold_37 for the scaffold). 54 are single-base substitutions drawn with seed 1 from the cache's known variants of the two sequences, their IDs the cache's identifiers. Sixteen exemplars per consequence-set combination the two references show, stratified by variant class and strand, forty-eight per combination carrying a protein-level term, plus the records the manifest's included_records name. The cache holds no organelle sequence and every transcript names genetic code table 1

generator: tools/vep-seeded-variants --records wide --seed 1 --fasta <genome> --sequence F1 --sequence JAFEKA010000047.1 over the converted cache, and 300 single-base substitutions drawn with seed 1 from the known variants of the same two sequences; Ensembl VEP over the two inputs under the corpus flags; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly F.catus_Fca126_mat1.0 --species felis_catus --dataset wide=<reference>=<the designed records> --dataset known=<reference>=<the known variants> --k 16 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --max-records 500 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --focus-term <frameshift_variant, inframe_deletion, inframe_insertion, protein_altering_variant, start_lost, start_retained_variant, stop_lost, stop_retained_variant, stop_gained, missense_variant, synonymous_variant, incomplete_terminal_codon_variant> --focus-k 48 --include <the named records> --covers species-cat-fca126 --covers genetic-code-tables --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --flank 5000 --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except <the transcripts on which a record changes one residue, the rows SIFT scores> --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 --variations <converted cache>/variations over the whole cache tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl VEP 116 F.catus_Fca126_mat1.0 cache (protein features kept for the DOMAINS column of the everything set; the variation slices hold the known variants within one base of a record); scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --reference <genome> --flank 5000 --record-flank 2000 over the pruned cache and a copy of the records that names each sequence as the cache does; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --no-stats for the manifest's run and each flag set; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (everything, hgvs-sift) and classify (the manifest's run and both flag sets, --field HGVSc --field HGVSp --field SIFT for the hgvs-sift set)

pruned_cache.variation_slices: the known variants within one base of a record under variations/<chr>/all_vars.gz with its .csi, as the Ensembl VEP cache lays them out: 57 on F1 and 0 on the scaffold
